knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A route is closed only when its bags have reached the collection point. A client receipt is not part of the route close.
A reset kit starts the next route ready. Selling the kit or re-emptying bins is not the purpose.
Used cloths go to laundering or drying as the site rules say. They are not left on the drop sheet or put into waste.

practicalCriteria: Confirms every full bag has reached its collection point before closing the route.
Empties and wipes the collection bin, returns the tote and tools, and places used cloths for laundering or drying.
Refills bottles, restocks liners, and records any shortage or missed area on the job sheet.
passRule: Knowledge checks: 80% pass mark, which for three questions means all three correct. Practical sign-off is separate and observed by an assessor.
evidenceRequired: Assessor observation of the route close
stopWorkCriteria: Route marked complete with bags at a collection point
Used cloths left in the path of walkways
